mandatory_context: R22 one successful image/png carrier by new ChatGPT chat, single invocation, not design skill
same_technical_wrapper: 请使用图片生成，只产出一张独立图片，不要回复文字。16:9横幅、真正透明背景、单行横排、仅准确的四个简体中文字「松间见月」，全部是深墨黑，四字清楚可辨认，笔画不得错漏。严禁其他字、字母、数字、标签、方案编号、风景、边框、拼图、海报、讲解板、背景装饰、阴影或图案。

A.treatment: neutral traditional Chinese Song-style baseline, four legible chars
A.full_prompt:
请使用图片生成，只产出一张独立图片，不要回复文字。16:9横幅、真正透明背景、单行横排、仅准确的四个简体中文字「松间见月」，全部是深墨黑，四字清楚可辨认，笔画不得错漏。严禁其他字、字母、数字、标签、方案编号、风景、边框、拼图、海报、讲解板、背景装饰、阴影或图案。
字标采用端正规范、易认的传统宋体排印，视觉大小和笔画粗细基本一致，字距自然，不使用夸张手写笔势、断笔、共笔或装饰性延长。它只是中性基线。

B.treatment: whole-word visual grammar: structure-conditioned signature strokes, negative space, coherent optical balance
B.full_prompt:
请使用图片生成，只产出一张独立图片，不要回复文字。16:9横幅、真正透明背景、单行横排、仅准确的四个简体中文字「松间见月」，全部是深墨黑，四字清楚可辨认，笔画不得错漏。严禁其他字、字母、数字、标签、方案编号、风景、边框、拼图、海报、讲解板、背景装饰、阴影或图案。
字标采用整组一致的原创书写造型语法，而非简单字体排印：保持正确汉字结构，在四字之间协调字重、字距、整体轮廓、倾斜与主笔收势。松字木旁要轻于右部；间字保留门框内清楚的留白；见字的主撇/右腿形成舒展但不夸张的方向性收笔；月字内横简洁、克制。四字仅以各自真实结构做有条件造型，共享含蓄流动的笔势，不能四字机械复制同一长飘笔或添加任何墨迹纹理。

design_hypothesis: Compared with ordinary Chinese Song-type baseline, the creator-derived holistic wordmark grammar produces stronger coherent design across varied Chinese structures, retaining readability
causal_limit: A/B different prompting complexity. Study can assess results but not isolate sole influence of a unique rule from prompt richness; no human aesthetic verdict without actual human review.

technical_fixed_across_arms: no extra characters, scenery, decoration, explanatory board
requirements.choose_model: use default available ChatGPT chat mode in both; if changed, log instead of assuming equal
requirements.output_dimensions: actual PNG bytes determine dimensions; UI may select size

evaluation_order: Generate A once in empty chat
Generate B once in separate empty chat
Collect original PNG bytes from ChatGPT Library not screenshots or extracted crops
Hash bytes, confirm PNG RGBA and text/presentation
Only if both pass technical gate prepare equal-crop label-masked visual comparison and show actual images
Record human verdict and holdout separately; do not infer from visual self-assessment

verdict_rule.both_valid: TECHNICAL_AB_VALID_ONLY; design comparison and human vote still PENDING
